corpus-02.translation: That head tilt was him sneaking a peek at the lyrics!

corpus-01.translation: Teacher, I really did my homework, but my dog ate it.

name-01.translation: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.translation: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

corpus-03.translation: No way, keeping a sense of mystery is nice.

errors.note: “不处”是拒绝处对象/交往的意思，译成“No way”变成了一般性的强烈否定，丢失了拒绝交往的含义。

slang-01.translation: That move was way too smooth—I'm completely losing it.

errors.note: “裂开”是网络用语，表示崩溃、受不了或震惊，而“losing it”更偏向失控或发疯，情绪强度和含义都有偏差。
“秀”指操作精彩、厉害，“smooth”只强调流畅，弱化了“惊艳、出彩”的褒义程度。

corpus-09.translation: Should we throw away this souvenir?

corpus-05.translation: It's just hilarious, so damn abstract. Who even gets this question?

errors.note: “damn”添加了原文没有的粗俗强调，语气比原文更重，字幕口语中略显过度。

corpus-07.translation: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-08.translation: Besides, his honest and down-to-earth vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out at all—you might even get a free meal out of that face.

corpus-06.translation: It seems to be true. I even came across leaked videos from his concert.

errors.note: “路透”指粉丝/路人拍摄的现场视频，并非“泄露视频”，leaked 改变了含义。

corpus-10.translation: Your idea is pretty out there.

errors.note: 缺少系动词和主语，英语中不成句，应为 "That sudden?" 改为 "That was so sudden?" 或 "So sudden?" 之类。
原文的"的吗"带有确认/反问语气，译文仅用名词短语加问号，语气和疑问焦点有所丢失。

corpus-12.translation: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-11.translation: Alright, I'll deal with all that toxic positivity when I get back to the country.

errors.note: “毒鸡汤”指有害的励志/心灵鸡汤式说教，译成“toxic positivity”偏向“有毒的正能量”这一特定概念，语义有偏差。

errors.span: when I get back to the country
errors.note: “回国”译成“get back to the country”生硬且指代不清，口语字幕中更自然应为“when I get back home/back to China”。

corpus-14.translation: Which is better, your proposal or your colleague's PPT?

corpus-17.translation: No way. These days even love comes with a price tag.

corpus-16.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrise photos on your feed every day.

errors.span: Why didn't you say so earlier?
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的感叹，译文语气偏正式、书面，缺少原文的惊讶/抱怨口吻。

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that pretentious look on his face and you know something's up. That kind of deadpan nonsense is comedy gold.

errors.note: “故作高深”指装出深奥难懂的样子，pretentious 偏“自命不凡/做作”，语义略有偏差，但可接受。
“一本正经的胡说八道”强调以严肃态度说荒唐话，deadpan 侧重面无表情，未完全传达“一本正经”的语义，属轻微偏差。

corpus-18.translation: No thanks, go play by yourself.

errors.note: “不处”是拒绝处对象/交往，不是“不用谢/不必了”，译成 No thanks 改变了拒绝的对象和含义。
“自己玩去”是带不耐烦语气的口语打发语，此译法偏中性、像对小孩说话，语气不够贴合。

corpus-19.translation: Look, the lottery numbers I bought are exactly the same as the winning numbers you mentioned yesterday.

errors.span: the winning numbers you mentioned yesterday
errors.note: 原文是“你昨天说的中奖号码”，即说话人买的号码与对方说的中奖号码相同；译文把“中奖号码”和“你昨天说的”拆开，变成“我买的号码”与“你昨天提到的中奖号码”相同，语义关系被改变，暗示对方昨天说的是中奖号码。

corpus-22.translation: I stayed up late watching your livestream last night and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.translation: Was in such a rush to leave that I grabbed a dishcloth instead of a towel and brought it to the office.

corpus-21.translation: On the subway, I ran into this guy who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-20.translation: Hajimi north-south green beans, I'm holding back internal injuries at my desk.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络流行语（源自日语“はちみ”/蜂蜜，常指可爱小动物），音译成 Hajimi 保留了发音但未传达梗义，属可接受的音译处理，仅提示术语处理。
“南北绿豆”是网络梗/无实义谐音串，直译为 north-south green beans 会让英文观众误以为是真实食材，意思传达偏差。

errors.span: I'm holding back internal injuries at my desk
errors.note: “憋出内伤”是夸张口语，指强忍笑意/情绪到内伤；直译 holding back internal injuries 生硬且易误解为真的受伤，不符合字幕口语风格。

corpus-28.translation: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.translation: Which is more suitable for obese people looking to lose fat: a treadmill, an elliptical, or a stationary bike?

corpus-24.translation: Not getting involved, the drama's too big to handle.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不交往/不掺和”，译成“Not getting involved”偏离了原意，属于误译。

errors.span: the drama's too big to handle
errors.note: “瓜太大了啃不动”是口语化网络梗，译文偏书面、生硬，缺少字幕口语的自然感。

corpus-34.translation: At work, I'm always interrupted by all kinds of messages and find it hard to focus on what I'm doing. Are there any methods to improve efficiency?

corpus-32.translation: I'm already running a fever, so please, aunties, just let me off the hook.

corpus-33.translation: Watching post-00s chat in Martian language

errors.note: “火星文”指网络俚语/文字游戏，直译为“Martian language”生硬且易误解为外星语言，宜用“Martian text”或“internet slang”等更自然的说法。

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't even, I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who doesn't have some embarrassing period pad buying story!

errors.note: “大家”是泛指的“everyone/you all”，译成“Come on”变成催促语气，与原意略有偏差。
名词堆叠生硬，英语更自然说法是“embarrassing story about buying period pads”。

corpus-39.translation: Its Douban rating of 9.4 also proves its quality.

corpus-38.translation: I was scrolling through videos and saw the giant jianbing guozi made by an auntie in Shandong, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the country?

corpus-41.translation: Others: A tiger with piercing eyes and a white forehead. Me: A Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

errors.span: A tiger with piercing eyes and a white forehead
errors.note: “吊睛白额虎”是《水浒传》中老虎的固定称谓，直译虽可理解，但作为字幕略显冗长生硬，可更简洁。
“巧乐兹”是品牌名，音译“Qiaolezi”可接受，但英文观众可能不熟悉，属轻微术语处理问题。

corpus-44.translation: I can't take it anymore—working overtime has completely numbed me.

corpus-40.translation: I can't even, happiness came way too suddenly.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与原文“我不行了”的直白口语语气不完全对应，略显随意/网络化。
表达偏生硬、书面化，字幕口语中更自然说法如“happiness came out of nowhere”，但意思无误。

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into games all the time?

corpus-42.translation: Hahaha I can't even, this batch of netizens is way too talented

errors.note: “this batch of”是“这届”的生硬直译，英语口语字幕里不自然，宜用“these netizens”或“this generation of netizens”。
“I can't even”是网络流行语，与“我不行了”的笑到不行的语境不完全对应，语气略偏，但可接受。

corpus-48.translation: I can't even, this is way too cute!

corpus-45.translation: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team is called, uh, what was it, Xiao Chao Team, right? I remember it all!

errors.note: 原文“那个啥”是口语化的模糊指代，译文添加了“uh, what was it”的填充语，属于轻微增译，但基本保留了不确定的语气。
原文“小潮team”中“team”为英文，译文将整个名称音译加意译处理，可接受，但若该团队有官方英文名应保持一致。

corpus-49.translation: I can't take it anymore, I know everything, I've been grinding so hard I'm going bald.

errors.span: I've been grinding so hard I'm going bald
errors.note: “肝到秃头”是夸张的网络用语，指熬夜/拼命到掉头发，译文按字面译成“grinding so hard I'm going bald”，意思基本传达，但“肝”作为熬夜/拼命的引申义未体现，略显直译。

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

ctx-02.translation: He said he won't be home for dinner tonight.

errors.note: 原文是“我妈”（我妈妈）在说话，译文却用“He”，把说话人性别搞错了，观众会误以为是男性在说话。

ctx-c02.translation: Keep it dry, or we'll have to replace it again.

ctx-c05.translation: The power of six wallets—your family must be loaded.

m-002.translation: It's recommended to take your parents to a physical store to try out the system's smoothness, and for memory, go with the 12+256G version.

errors.note: “内存”指运行内存/RAM，译为 memory 易与存储空间混淆，宜用 RAM 或运行内存对应表达。
英文中容量单位通常写作 256GB，缺 B 略显不规范。

m-003.translation: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?

errors.note: “新手村”是游戏术语，英文游戏社区通常说 “starter village” 或 “starting village”；“newbie village” 能看懂但不够地道。

errors.span: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?
errors.note: “我请问呢”是带讽刺、反问语气的口语表达，直译成 “May I ask” 显得生硬、过于正式，没有传达出吐槽语气。

m-005.translation: Seeing a little dog on the street wagging its tail at me

ctx-c38.translation: Sometimes the aim is so terrifyingly good that viewers suspect cheating, and the chat just spams "666" without even bothering to boo.

errors.span: the aim is so terrifyingly good
errors.note: “手感”指投篮手感/状态，译为“aim”（瞄准）略有偏差，应为“shooting touch”或“hot hand”之类。
原文“直接666刷屏”未明确指聊天，但“刷屏”通常指弹幕/评论，译作“chat”可接受；不过“666”作为中文网络用语直接保留，英文观众可能不理解，属轻微问题。

m-001.translation: Let me tell you a secret: search for the curator and keep a Douyin virtual pet for fun.

errors.note: “主理人”在此语境指抖音上的账号/店铺主理人，译成“the curator”会让观众误解为博物馆策展人，意思明显偏差。
“养只抖音电子宠物”是口语化玩梗表达，译文偏直译生硬，缺少字幕口语感。

ctx-c57.translation: That last line killed me, add a bit more, it got the boss completely heated up, when a socially anxious person finally explodes they're seriously fierce

errors.note: 原文“加点啊”是让老板加（料/量）的意思，译文“add a bit more”缺少宾语且指向不明，容易误解为让说话人自己加。

errors.span: it got the boss completely heated up
errors.note: “got the boss completely heated up”搭配生硬，英语更自然说法是“got the boss completely riled up/worked up”。

errors.span: when a socially anxious person finally explodes they're seriously fierce
errors.note: 整句直译痕迹重、口语节奏不自然，不像英文字幕口语。

m-006.translation: Did you know our school cafeteria was actually free today?

m-004.translation: When playing poker, some people always like to quote movie lines.

m-007.translation: Hahahaha that mental image is way too vivid

m-010.translation: Recently I've noticed so many of my friends are into stand-up comedy, even my parents have started watching it.

m-008.translation: I'm not obligated to tell you. It's my little secret.

m-011.translation: I just found out my mom gave away my prized figurine collection.

m-009.translation: Can you become a master by messing around with abstract stuff? Are you the plagiarism police?

errors.note: “玩抽象”是网络用语，指玩梗/搞抽象表达，译成“messing around with abstract stuff”偏字面、生硬，不够口语化。

m-014.translation: Last night while gaming, I realized you can hold this button to unleash a special move.

m-013.translation: Some people say I look really fair, like I'm mixed-race.

m-012.translation: This document must be finished reading today.

errors.note: “be finished reading”搭配不成立，应为“must be read/finished by today”，此处语法错误导致句子不通顺。

m-015.translation: Bestie, I can't even, this gossip is too explosive.

m-016.translation: Remember to bring a lightweight large cloth bag to hold everything; a backpack is inconvenient on the beach.

m-017.translation: This streamer's story is way too outrageous.

m-019.translation: I really can't take it anymore, my stomach is about to explode.

m-018.translation: This game's difficulty is just ridiculous.

m-022.translation: Li Zongheng's performance was absolutely brilliant—he could be on the big stage in no time.

m-020.translation: And that "so what, what can you do" stuff makes me want to crap, it's as brainwashing as a virus.

errors.span: so what, what can you do
errors.note: “那咋了又能怎”是口语化的“那又怎样/你能怎样”的抱怨语气，译文拆成“so what, what can you do”改变了原意，把“又能怎”误译成“你能做什么”，意思出现偏差。
“洗脑程度堪比病毒”是口语夸张比喻，译文“as brainwashing as a virus”生硬且搭配不自然，英语中“brainwashing”作形容词性比较不地道。

m-023.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? I'm heading to make up the lesson right now.

errors.span: Why didn't you say so earlier?
errors.note: 原文“我去不早说”是口语化的感叹，译文用完整疑问句，语气偏正式、不够口语化。

errors.span: I'm heading to make up the lesson right now.
errors.note: “make up the lesson”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“go to my makeup class”，但意思无误。

m-027.translation: What exactly do you mean by "yes-man"?

m-024.translation: Everyone sitting here must be crying with anxiety by now!

errors.span: must be crying with anxiety by now
errors.note: “急哭”是夸张的口语说法，意思是“急得不行/快急死了”，并非真的在哭；译成“crying with anxiety”把夸张说法当成字面意思，语气和含义都偏了。
“在座的各位”是称呼观众的口语说法，译成“Everyone sitting here”偏生硬、像描述场景，不像字幕里对观众说话。

m-025.translation: Starting the tutorial at zero frames, huh? Skipping even the warm-up—this coach must be a former esports player.

errors.span: Starting the tutorial at zero frames
errors.note: “0帧教学”指零帧起步/毫无铺垫直接开教，译成“at zero frames”字面化且语义偏差，观众难以理解原意。

errors.span: this coach must be a former esports player
errors.note: 原文“电竞选手转行的吧”带调侃推测语气，译文语气较肯定，略失原句的不确定与吐槽感。

m-028.translation: Your pronunciation is so bizarrely catchy.

errors.note: “魔性”指发音怪异、洗脑或搞笑，而“catchy”意为朗朗上口、容易记住，语义偏差明显，且“bizarrely catchy”搭配生硬。

m-029.translation: Made me waste so much time.

m-026.translation: And now every time I just say, well, deal with it, so he can get a taste of what it's like to have a grievance he can't voice.

errors.span: so he can get a taste of what it's like to have a grievance he can't voice
errors.note: 原文“让他也体会下”是祈使/目的语气（让他去体会），译文用“so he can get a taste”把因果关系说得更明确，但基本意思保留，属轻微偏差。

m-031.translation: Didn't you notice he spins around on the red carpet at every big event?

m-032.translation: I've noticed that a guy has been marking my water bottle lately.

m-035.translation: The PPT the teacher showed in class was absolutely hilarious.

m-036.translation: When I watch funny videos, I hold back and don't dare laugh out loud.

m-033.translation: Bro B acts out the real scene of paying attention in class back in his student days when he suddenly gets a burst of inexplicable anger

errors.note: “b哥”是网络昵称/称呼，译作“Bro B”略显生硬，且与中文原称呼的语感不完全对应。

errors.span: acts out the real scene of paying attention in class back in his student days when he suddenly gets a burst of inexplicable anger
errors.note: 整句过长且书面化，作为字幕不够口语自然，可拆分或简化。

m-037.translation: Let me show you a special trick.

m-034.translation: I can't stay in this group anymore.

errors.note: “这群”指这群人/这个群体，译成“this group”偏指群组/团体，且“没法待了”意为待不下去、无法忍受，译文“can't stay”只表达不能留下，丢失了“受不了”的语义。

m-038.translation: I suggest you look at all of them, after all, that question last year's test takers said "definitely won't be on the exam" still ended up appearing.

errors.span: that question last year's test takers said "definitely won't be on the exam" still ended up appearing
errors.note: 句子结构混乱、语序不通顺，读者难以顺畅解析，应重组为类似 the question that last year's test takers said would "definitely not appear" still ended up on the exam。

m-039.translation: I heard Nestlé is making an indie film.

m-041.translation: That's so bizarre, what kind of brand-new tactic is this?

m-043.translation: I can't even, your contact name is making me crack up, that's brutal.

m-040.translation: I can't even, this looks way too much like it.

errors.span: this looks way too much like it
errors.note: “这也太像了吧”指某人/某物与另一对象相似，译文用“like it”指代不明且生硬，未能清楚表达“太像了”的所指，意思有偏差。
“I can't even”是网络化口语，与“我不行了”的惊叹语气不完全对应，略显不自然。

m-044.translation: This is way funnier than a Spring Festival Gala sketch.

m-047.translation: Planning to start learning Python programming with absolutely zero foundation—where's the best place to begin?

m-042.translation: Back in the day, I was full of drive and spirit, playing my skill cards so well that money poured in from all directions. Now I've sunk to shining shoes here.

errors.note: “一手技能牌”是比喻，指自己掌握的一手技能/本领，译成字面的“skill cards”会让观众误以为在打牌，意思偏差明显。
“意气风发”译得偏书面、解释性，作为字幕口语不够自然。

m-045.translation: I can't take it anymore, waking people up in the middle of the night is really too much to handle.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此语境下更接近“我受不了了/我撑不住了”，译成“I can't take it anymore”语气偏重，但基本可接受。

errors.span: waking people up in the middle of the night is really too much to handle
errors.note: 整句偏书面、冗长，不像口语字幕；可更简洁自然，如“waking people up in the middle of the night is really rough”。

m-048.translation: My blind date talked about her cat the whole time.

m-046.translation: If you've got fleas, go take a shower. You've made my phone smell nasty.

errors.span: You've made my phone smell nasty
errors.note: 原文“把我手机整的骚哄的”指说话人自己身上有跳蚤味沾到手机，译文用“You've made”把责任归到对方，且“smell nasty”弱化了“骚哄的”那种刺鼻骚味的程度。
原文“就去洗澡”语气更直接随意，译文尚可但略生硬，可更口语化。

m-049.translation: As a new content creator, I've noticed that my video views are decent, but the comment section is always pretty quiet.

m-051.translation: Quick, let me pinch myself to see if I'm dreaming.

m-050.translation: Remember, you don't need much equipment at the start—the key is to shoot more and practice more.

m-054.translation: If it's all about luck, why do we still have to look at equipment?

m-053.translation: I've been under a lot of work pressure lately, often so anxious that I can't sleep. Are there any ways to relieve it?

m-052.translation: You're already crying from panic—this is colder than the cold palace.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法，指急得快要哭出来，并非真的在哭；“already crying from panic”把它译成已经哭了，改变了原意。

errors.span: this is colder than the cold palace
errors.note: “冷宫”直译为“cold palace”对不熟悉中国宫廷文化的英语观众不够清楚，且“colder than the cold palace”读起来生硬，可加注或意译。

m-055.translation: During a dorm inspection for contraband, a condom fell out from under my roommate's pillow.

errors.note: 原文“舍友”指说话人的室友，译文却写成“my roommate's pillow”，把枕头归为室友所有，改变了所属关系，应改为“a roommate's pillow”或“my roommate's pillow”需与“舍友”对应——实际问题是“my”使室友变成说话人的室友，而原文并未明确是“我的”室友，属增译/误译。

m-057.translation: My mom said she wants to introduce me to a blind date.

errors.span: introduce me to a blind date
errors.note: “介绍相亲对象”指介绍一个潜在的相亲人选，而“introduce me to a blind date”暗示介绍给一个已经确定的相亲对象/约会，意思有偏差。

m-059.translation: Saw a video of a delivery guy delivering food in the rain

errors.note: 字幕中省略主语“I”虽可接受，但读起来像片段，作为独立字幕句略显生硬。

m-060.translation: The exam answer is on page 50 of the textbook.

m-061.translation: What do I do, girls? I'm totally swooning over this move.

m-063.translation: Help me grab the limited-edition sneakers.

m-058.translation: I'll deal with you when I get back to the country after the next update.

errors.note: “再”在此处是“再次/以后”的口语用法（“再更新”指下次更新时或之后），译文将其理解为“下一次更新之后”，把时间关系译得过于具体，且与“回国弄你”的威胁语气脱节，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: I'll deal with you when I get back to the country after the next update.
errors.note: 整句过于书面、冗长，不像字幕口语；中文“弄你”是口语化威胁，译文语气偏正式生硬。

m-062.translation: My feed is full of people posting 666, and it's making my scalp tingle just looking at it.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络用语，意为“厉害/牛”，直接保留为“666”会让英文观众误以为是数字或恶魔数字，未传达原意。
“头皮发麻”是习语，表示尴尬/不适/受不了，直译成“scalp tingle”在英文中不自然，观众难以理解其引申义。

m-066.translation: I can't understand a single word in the English listening exam.

m-065.translation: There's a guy in the next class who strikes a brooding pose in front of the mirror after class and says he's the lead in that xxx drama.

m-064.translation: I have a teacher qualification certificate interview next week. Are there any special things to pay attention to in the trial teaching segment?

errors.note: “试讲”在教师资格证面试语境中通常译为 “mock teaching” 或 “demo lesson”，“trial teaching segment” 不够规范，但尚可理解。

m-069.translation: What does this Moments post from my partner mean?

m-068.translation: I can't take it anymore, ahhh, listening to this is making my brain freeze solid

errors.note: “啊啊啊”用“ahhh”这种拼写显得随意、像网络用语，字幕口语中更自然的是“ahh”或“ugh”，不过意思仍能理解。

m-070.translation: I just shared a meme I'd been saving for a whole year in the group chat, and it totally flopped.

m-067.translation: I can't even, I'm dying laughing, this impression is so spot-on, it's literally a copy of the original, absolutely 666, not even trying to hide it, this drama queen is the real deal.

errors.note: “666”是中文网络俚语，直译成英文观众无法理解，应改为“awesome/insane”等英文对应表达。

errors.span: this drama queen is the real deal
errors.note: “戏精本精”指此人本身就是戏精，译成“the real deal”略泛，未准确传达“本精”的自指强调意味。

m-074.translation: Ideally somewhere good for taking photos.

m-071.translation: You're already crying from panic. Reply right now, right now.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张说法，指急得快要哭出来，并非真的在哭；“crying from panic”把夸张语气坐实成实际哭泣，意思有偏差。
重复“right now”显得生硬，不像自然口语字幕，可用“reply, reply”或“answer me now”等更口语的表达。

m-073.translation: Li Zongheng stars in a story about a father-in-law who loves to pull pranks, showing the funny Spring Festival moments as this generation of young people starts taking charge.

m-072.translation: I can't take it anymore, this is way too intense.

m-076.translation: You'll need to prepare: 200g cake flour, 100g butter, 60g powdered sugar, and 1 egg.

m-075.translation: I want to check the cards—this meme comes from a classic line in Stephen Chow's movie God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai.

errors.span: God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai
errors.note: 《法国赌神》应为《赌侠》（God of Gamblers II），而 God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai 是另一部影片，片名指代错误。

m-077.translation: Oh my god, this flavor is absolutely amazing.

errors.note: “我勒个豆”是网络化、俏皮的感叹语，译成“Oh my god”偏直白、宗教化，口语俏皮感有所流失。
“太顶了”是网络俚语，表示“非常棒/很上头”，译成“absolutely amazing”意思对但偏书面、平淡，缺少俚语味。

m-078.translation: I'm already halfway done, I've written 50 slides for the PPT, and now you're telling me I might have to start all over?

m-079.translation: How's the new character from this gacha pull?

errors.note: 原文“可以可以”是重复“可以”（“行/好”），译成“sure, sure”改变了意思，属于误译。

m-082.translation: I actually stayed to watch the Spring Festival Gala, and this performance is just too amazing!

m-081.translation: Has no one noticed how smart she is? She built her following with abstract content and succeeded, then switched to a beauty-focused style to give her fans a huge contrast.

errors.note: “抽象”是网络用语，指荒诞/无厘头风格，译成“abstract content”会让英文观众误解为抽象艺术类内容，意思偏差明显。

errors.span: built her following with abstract content and succeeded
errors.note: “用抽象起号”是口语化网络表达，译文偏书面、解释性，不够像字幕口语。

m-083.translation: I can't even, this is way too cool!

m-084.translation: I recommend doing 20 targeted practice questions every day, and you'll see progress in a month.

m-087.translation: I just finished writing a business plan. Take a look and see what you think.

m-085.translation: She'll probably laugh when she sees this meme, right?

m-089.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in, don't let the boss find out.

m-086.translation: Our teammate's 0-10 and still bossing everyone around like crazy.

m-088.translation: I've been thinking about starting yoga at home recently, but I'm a complete beginner and have no idea where to start.

m-090.translation: How do you spot a cheater when playing cards?

m-091.translation: Only things so abstract that no one can understand them count as a challenge.

m-092.translation: What challenge should we take on next? Leave a comment below.

m-094.translation: Hahaha I can't even, your description is way too funny.

m-098.translation: Why are you so averse to internet slang?

m-093.translation: What the hell is wrong with them? I can't take this anymore.

errors.note: 原文“有病吧”是说话人对自己或泛指的感叹，并未明确指“他们”，译成 them 引入了原文没有的第三人称对象，意思有偏差。

errors.span: What the hell is wrong with them?
errors.note: 原文是简短的口语感叹，译文拆成完整问句并加 the hell，语气偏重且不够口语化。

m-095.translation: This joke is so funny it should be on CCTV.

m-100.translation: I recommend downloading the Keep or Xunji app and following the free courses to work out—it's safe and systematic.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络用语，表示“厉害/牛”，直译成“Six six six”会让英语观众无法理解，应意译为类似“Awesome”或“That's sick”的表达。

m-097.translation: Do you know how to solve this problem?

m-099.translation: You get what "Workplace Warmth" means now, right?

m-101.translation: This is the first time I've felt so directly how big my internet addiction really is.

errors.span: how big my internet addiction really is
errors.note: “how big my internet addiction really is”略显生硬直译，口语字幕中更自然说法如“how addicted to the internet I really am”。

m-102.translation: Did you know that Guangtou Qiang's voice actor is actually a top-tier singer?

m-104.translation: What memes are Gen Z into these days?

m-103.translation: If it weren't for this damn job keeping me stuck here every day, I'd book a flight to Xi'an right now and come settle the score with you!

m-105.translation: You should've told me earlier, I wasted so long trying to figure out the character relationships.

m-108.translation: I'm begging you, just let our team go.

m-107.translation: I rushed down to confront them, but got so worked up that I bit my tongue. Now it hurts so much that tears are coming out.

m-112.translation: Are tutorials these days really this half-assed?

m-109.translation: Ha, it's fine, I'm watching the movie you mentioned at the New Year's Eve gala.

errors.span: at the New Year's Eve gala
errors.note: 原文“跨年晚会”是说话人所在/观看的场合，译文将其处理为看电影的地点，改变了意思（应为“I'm watching the movie you mentioned on the New Year's Eve gala”）。

m-113.translation: I've hit a plateau in my grad school exam prep. I'm anxious every day and can't focus on studying. How should I adjust my mindset and improve my efficiency?

m-110.translation: You can set up a basic system within a budget of 2000, just remember to leave space for outlets and ensure network coverage.

errors.note: 原文“预算2000内”指2000元人民币，译文只写“2000”未标明货币单位，英文观众可能误以为是美元或其他货币，金额含义偏差明显。

m-114.translation: My mom said if I don't find a partner soon, I shouldn't bother coming home.

m-115.translation: Keep your resume to one page, keep the layout clean, and absolutely no typos.

m-116.translation: I ate the last piece of cake.

m-122.translation: This is the first time I've seen such a luxurious villa.

m-117.translation: Alright, once I'm back in the country, I'll officiate your wedding.

errors.note: “证婚”指作为证婚人见证婚礼，并非主持/操办婚礼，officiate 意为主持仪式，语义有偏差。

m-123.translation: When traveling with parents, it's best to choose a leisure city with convenient transportation and well-developed facilities.

m-121.translation: I can't take this anymore, has this kid lost his mind?

m-118.translation: So you're watching the Spring Festival Gala, huh? Then let me just fast-forward you straight to New Year's Eve.

m-120.translation: I've been wanting to learn how to make bread lately, but I have zero foundation. Where should I start as a beginner?

m-119.translation: So abstract—a full picture of young people's mental state these days.

errors.note: “太抽象了”是网络口语，指荒诞、难以理解，直译成“So abstract”在英语里不自然，观众可能误解为字面意义的抽象。

errors.span: a full picture of young people's mental state these days
errors.note: “一览”译成“a full picture of”偏书面、冗长，不像字幕口语，可用更简洁自然的表达。

m-124.translation: I stayed up late last night and I'm so sleepy.

m-128.translation: The boss said our bonus will double this month.

m-126.translation: What's going on with suddenly laughing out loud at an anatomy diagram?

errors.span: What's going on with suddenly laughing out loud at an anatomy diagram?
errors.note: 译文把口语化的“突然笑出声是怎么回事”译成较生硬、书面化的结构，作为字幕不够自然口语。

m-130.translation: That metaphor is way too abstract.

m-127.translation: I'm saying, why do you care so much about people saying "six six six"?

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络用语（“666”，意为厉害/牛），直译成“six six six”会让英语观众无法理解其含义，应译为“666”或“awesome”之类的表达。

m-129.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in. Don't let them think you're a psycho.

m-132.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? I'm running home right now to change my clothes.

m-125.translation: This is Abstract Bro, not like B Bro who quietly does his exercises.

errors.note: “抽象哥”是网络绰号，直译成 Abstract Bro 生硬，观众难以理解其“行为抽象/离谱”的含义。
“b哥”作为绰号直译为 B Bro 不自然，且与“抽象哥”的译法风格不一致。
“做题”指刷题/做题目，exercises 偏“练习”，且整句偏书面，不像字幕口语。

m-131.translation: I can't even. The sun must be rising in the west.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，语气偏轻佻，与“我不行了”表达吃不消/受不了的口语语气不完全对应。

errors.span: The sun must be rising in the west.
errors.note: “must be”表示推测，而原文“太阳打西边出来了”是习语式感叹，语气更肯定、更夸张，译文略弱化了原意。

m-133.translation: For food, just go around the wet market—it's cheap and authentic.

m-134.translation: My partner says they want to take a month to cool off with me.

m-136.translation: If the area is large, Mesh distributed routing is the best solution—it's a bit more expensive, but you get full coverage with no dead zones.

m-135.translation: So what? You got won over by their looks, huh?

m-138.translation: No way, I'm staying home and doing nothing.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不谈恋爱”，译成“No way”改变了意思，变成单纯拒绝。

m-140.translation: Check out this dark joke I just learned.

m-137.translation: The power of six wallets, with per capita savings of a million

errors.span: with per capita savings of a million
errors.note: “人均存款百万”是夸张/反讽的说法，译文直译为“人均存款一百万”会让英文观众误以为是事实陈述，丢失了原文的讽刺语气。

errors.span: The power of six wallets, with per capita savings of a million
errors.note: 用逗号加 with 结构拼接两个短语，作为字幕显得生硬，不像口语化字幕。

m-142.translation: My mom insists on setting me up on a blind date.

m-143.translation: This exam was way too hard, I had no idea how to do it.

m-141.translation: Please, I really want to rank up. I'm begging you, don't leave.

m-139.translation: The pair of shoes I just grabbed is actually a pre-sale.

errors.span: The pair of shoes I just grabbed
errors.note: 原文“刚刚抢到的那双鞋”是话题/宾语前置，指“那双刚抢到的鞋”，译文改成“我抢到的那双鞋”，把焦点从“鞋”转到“我”，且“抢到”译为 grabbed 未体现抢购含义，语义有偏差。
原文说“那双鞋其实是预售（商品）”，译文说“这双鞋是一场预售”，把商品说成预售活动，意思错误。
预售商品通常说 pre-sale item / pre-order，单说 a pre-sale 指预售活动，术语不当。

m-144.translation: I recommend the figure reasoning section of Huatu Module Treasure Book—the explanations are very systematic.

errors.note: “图形”在公考语境指图形推理（图形推理题），译成“figure reasoning”不是该考试术语的规范说法，应为“graphic reasoning”或“figure/图形推理”的既定译法，术语不当。
书名《华图模块宝典》被逐字直译，作为专有名词应保留或采用通行译名，直译读起来生硬且不易识别。

m-147.translation: But I think it's really sacred, that's a family heirloom-level thing!

errors.note: “heirloom-level thing”生硬直译，字幕口语中更自然说法如“it's basically a family heirloom”。

m-146.translation: I can't even, hahaha, he's so talented

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与原文“我不行了”的直白口语语气略有偏差，但意思可接受。

m-149.translation: My boss suddenly asked me to go on a business trip abroad.

m-148.translation: That's so bizarre, it reminds me of my classmate. Back in elementary school, he marveled at how pale I was and asked if I was Caucasian.

m-150.translation: My dad said all it took to win my mom over back then was one meal.

m-145.translation: Sounds like you're still not thinking straight. A 996 corporate drone like you is best off just lounging at home, and the delivery guy is my best buddy.

errors.span: Sounds like you're still not thinking straight
errors.note: “还没清醒”指醉酒/迷糊状态，译成“not thinking straight”（思路不清）语义偏移，口语字幕里略显生硬。
“社畜”译为 corporate drone 意思接近，但“996社畜”作为网络梗，drone 偏书面，字幕口语感稍弱。
“葛优躺”是特定瘫躺姿势的网络梗，lounging 只表达“懒散待着”，丢失了瘫躺的形象感，属轻微文化意象缺失。
“外卖小哥”特指外卖骑手，delivery guy 可泛指快递/送货员，指代略宽泛。
